# Syrtis v1.3.0

**The tray tooltip names the length of the window it follows.**

- When the length of the tracked quota window is known, the tray tooltip shows it after the window's name, for example "Session (5h)" or "Weekly (7d)". While a window's length is still unknown, the tooltip reads as before. ([#253](https://github.com/Nanako0129/Syrtis-Windows/pull/253))
